content.title: Plant List
content.summary: The Arvada Land Development Code mandates the use of drought-tolerant and native plant species for landscaping projects to comply with local standards. Residents can access the City of Arvada Plant List to find suitable species that thrive in the area's climate.
content.body:
The Arvada Land Development Code (LDC) requires drought-tolerant and native plant species to be used according to the [Landscaping and Buffering](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=LADECOARCO_CH4ENSIDE_ART4-6LABU) standards. All landscaping projects in Arvada can benefit from including species that do well in our climate.

## Explore the Plant List

Download the [City of Arvada Plant List (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/195)
